ITEM.PTXT: By adopting a stainless steel sheet exhaust manifold, weight has been reduced and corrosion resistance improved, and catalyst warm-up immediately after engine start has been accelerated to reduce emissions.
A three-way catalyst integrated with the exhaust manifold has been adopted. This accelerates warm-up of the catalytic converter, improving emission performance immediately after engine start.
A heat insulator has been provided to cover the entire manifold. Also, holes have been provided to cool the manifold, achieving both protection of surrounding parts and cooling of the manifold.

By setting the exhaust gas entry angle between the exhaust manifold and three-way catalyst to 0° and enlarging the cross section of the pipe junction, the exhaust gas flow has been smoothed to improve performance.
